payload.meta_title: Honeymoon Planner vs Travel Agent: Questions to Ask
payload.meta_title_alt: Honeymoon Planner or Travel Agent: What to Ask First
payload.meta_description: Weighing a honeymoon planner against a travel agent? The questions to ask about what each will do, how they are paid and who helps when plans change.
payload.meta_notes: Title 51 chars, description 149 chars. Australian English, no em dashes, no figures, no 'best', no 'which is better'.

outline.h2: Start with the questions you ask yourselves
outline.answers: NY PAA 'Is it worth getting a travel agent for a honeymoon?'; related 'Should I use a travel agent for honeymoon'; variant 'do i need a travel agent for honeymoon'; WeddingWire 'Travel Agent vs Self'
h3: How much of the planning do you want to hand over?
Is the honeymoon straight after the wedding, or later?
How many moving parts does the trip have?
outline.notes: Frames DIY, agent and planner as options without ranking them. No superiority claims, no figures.

outline.h2: Questions about what they will actually do
outline.answers: Sydney PAA 'What is the difference between a travel agent and a travel planner?' and 'What are two types of travel agencies?'; Reddit snippet on agents who book hotels but not flights
h3: Will you design the trip, or book what we choose?
Who looks after flights, transfers and the days in between?
Do you work across suppliers, or with a set list?
outline.notes: The comparison is built from these answers, not definitions. Link /travel (anchor 'wedding and honeymoon travel') and honeymoon-planning-service if live.

outline.h2: Questions about how they are paid
outline.answers: Sydney PAA 'How do travel advisors get paid?'; NY PAA 'How much does a travel agent cost for a honeymoon?' and 'Is it cheaper to plan a trip with a travel agent?'; NY related 'Free travel agent honeymoon'; Reddit 'Honeymoon travel agents are free?'
outline.notes: Questions only: Is there a planning fee? Do you earn commission from the places you book? Is the quote in AUD? Is it in writing? No claims about how the industry charges, no figures. Hand off to honeymoon-planner-cost (if live). Moneysmart for planning the spend.

outline.h2: Questions about what happens when plans change
outline.answers: Sydney PAA 'What are the disadvantages of using a travel agent?'; gap: no page-one result covers changes, cancellations or consumer rights
h3: Who do we contact while we are away?
What happens if a flight or booking changes?
What does our travel insurance need to cover?
outline.notes: ACCC for consumer rights and Smartraveller for insurance and travel advice. The Knot angle (ask about licensing and insurance) rephrased as a question, not copied. [[VERIFY: ACCC and Smartraveller deep pages]]

outline.h2: When the honeymoon follows a destination wedding
outline.answers: Brief audience (destination wedding couples); gap: no result connects wedding travel with the honeymoon
outline.notes: The one brand section: Wedded Concierge plans wedding travel and the honeymoon as one journey (brand-facts wording only). CTA /wonderland-concierge, anchor 'Wedded Concierge'. Link /destination-honeymoon-packages.

outline.answers: PAA and related searches across Sydney and New York
outline.notes: FAQPage schema. No figures in any answer.
